group.passage:
The common mola, one of the largest bony fish, is native to tropical and temperate waters around the world. It is a huge fish with a bizarre appearance. Externally, it is oval-shaped, and its body is flattened out, with its dorsal and ventral fins extended vertically. It appears that the fish has only a head without a tail. In addition, it has four teeth that are fused together to form a beak-like structure. Biologically, it is related to the puffer fish.
The common mola can grow up to three meters long and four meters high, with a weight of around 2.3 tons, making it one of the heaviest fish on earth. Basically, males are smaller in size than females. It has a habit of floating near the water’s surface horizontally so that sea birds can help remove parasites from its chunky body. When the fish feels startled or threatened, its skin color will turn lighter or darker.
The diet of the common mola typically consists of jellyfish, squid, and small fish. To eat its primary prey, jellyfish, the fish has developed a thick skin that can protect itself against attacks, and its beak-like mouth is hard enough to cut the food into pieces easily. Although the common mola is large and intimidating in appearance, it is actually docile. Swimming with them is usually not dangerous. However, the fish poses a hazard to navigators because it often collides with small boats, causing considerable damage to propellers due to its size and weight.
When it comes to its natural predators, the common mola succumbs to killer whales, sharks, and sea lions. Sea lions, in particular, act aggressively towards this species. They hunt it in sport, tearing its fin and leaving the defenseless fish to die. Furthermore, the meat of this saltwater fish is seen as a delicacy in many Asian countries. However, before the meat is consumed, it is important to ensure that it does not contain toxins, as the meat may be poisonous, just like puffer fish. Currently, the common mola is listed as a vulnerable species by IUCN. Thus, it is time for governments around the world to raise the awareness of protecting this fish.

figures.caption: 第2題選項 (A)–(D) 圖片
figures.description: 第2題的四個選項都是黑白線條魚類圖，沒有文字。(A) 身體圓鼓鼓、像氣球般膨脹，全身布滿斑點與細刺點，嘴小，身體後端有一般的扇形尾鰭。(B) 頭頂伸出一根末端帶誘餌的長釣竿狀觸鬚，大嘴張開露出尖牙，體色深暗，後端有扇形尾鰭。(C) 身體扁平呈橢圓形，雙眼在同一側，體表布滿斑點，身體邊緣圍著一圈長長的鰭，後端有扇形尾鰭。(D) 身體側扁、呈高大的卵圓形，上方一片高高豎起的背鰭、下方一片長長的腹側鰭，身體後端截斷成波浪狀邊緣、沒有真正的尾巴，看起來只有頭部，嘴小如鳥喙。

questions.stem: What’s the purpose of the passage?

options.A: To detail the information of a huge fish species.
options.B: To introduce the largest and heaviest bony fish.
options.C: To alert fishermen to the danger of hitting fish.
options.D: To stress the importance of protecting marine life.

options.B: ［圖］頭頂伸出一根末端帶誘餌的長釣竿狀觸鬚，大嘴張開露出尖牙，體色深暗，身體後端有扇形尾鰭。
options.C: ［圖］身體扁平呈橢圓形，雙眼長在同一側，體表布滿斑點，身體邊緣圍著一圈長長的鰭，後端有扇形尾鰭。
options.D: ［圖］身體側扁、呈高大的卵圓形，上方有一片高高豎起的背鰭、下方有一片長長的腹側鰭，身體後端截斷成波浪狀邊緣、沒有真正的尾巴，看起來像只有一個頭，嘴小如鳥喙。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following statements is true about the common mola?

options.A: The common mola is a fierce and dangerous fish species due to its size, weight, and hard teeth.
options.B: The common mola feeds mainly on jellyfish, but it eats sea birds and small fish as well.
options.C: The predator of the common mola may attack it and then leave it to die of injury.
options.D: The skin of the common mola will become thicker if it finds itself under threat.
